title: Mediterranean Prawn Ceviche
description: A refreshing and light dish that combines the flavors of the Mediterranean with the sweetness of prawns. Perfect for a hot summer day.

ingredients.name: prawns
ingredients.notes: Large, fresh prawns are essential for this recipe

ingredients.name: lemon juice
ingredients.notes: Freshly squeezed lemon juice is a must

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality, extra-virgin olive oil

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.notes: Mince the garlic and let it infuse the flavors

ingredients.name: red onion
ingredients.notes: Thinly slice the red onion and add it to the mix

ingredients.name: fresh parsley
ingredients.notes: Chop the fresh parsley and sprinkle it on top

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: Use a flaky sea salt to bring out the flavors

ingredients.name: black pepper
ingredients.notes: Freshly ground black pepper is a must

instructions: Rinse the prawns under cold water and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a large bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the prawns to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the prawns to 'cook' in the acidity of the lemon juice.
Just before serving, stir in the chopped red onion and parsley.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the ceviche immediately, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
